title: fix: keep refreshed upstream changes out of managed task diffs
body: ## What Problem This Solves After a local managed workspace accepts a refreshed upstream base, Review can include upstream-only changes when the checkout's shared default-branch refs still point to an older commit. That makes a small task look larger and exposes upstream commits in the task's Review history. ## User Impact Review now compares all changes against the managed workspace's accepted source base and uses the same base for branch history and individual-commit admission. Uncommitted content remains relative to HEAD, and an admitted individual commit still shows its real first-parent diff. Authorized archived reads and the existing fallback for workspaces without a stored projection remain available. The change requires no configuration, migration, ref fetch, or worktree reconciliation. Remote repository and stored-artifact reads keep their existing behavior. ## Why This Change Was Made The workspace owner already records the accepted base, and the Git diff implementation already accepts it. The local route was omitting that input and inferring a base from shared refs instead. A narrow state-worker read now returns only the accepted base and session binding facts. The local consumer checks the agent, session identity, and managed registry identity/path, retains the current session lifecycle and source guards across Git reads, and passes the selected base to the existing diff owner. It does not load the projection's manifests or recovery payloads. A normal session reset can advance the current lifecycle while preserving the same workspace and accepted base; Review remains available immediately, without reconciling the projection. ## Evidence The regression runs the actual local diff route against real Git and existing workspace/registry writers. With a deliberately stale `origin/HEAD`, the unchanged implementation returned `task.txt` plus `upstream.txt`; only `task.txt` belongs to the accepted-base comparison. The same scenario covers working edits before committing, the committed task afterward, exact totals and history, empty HEAD-relative uncommitted output, upstream-commit rejection, preserved individual-commit content, archived reads, ownership mismatches, and absent-projection fallback. It also observes that projection reads perform no data SQL on the caller thread. Changed-file formatting/lint and the selected production/test consumer type checks pass. `pnpm test src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-diff.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` passes all 24 tests in 25.02 seconds wall time; the new regression takes 0.998 seconds. The three adjacent repository/incognito/workspace-store files pass another 24 tests in 44.10 seconds. Hosted CI passes on the corrected head; workflow wall time is 658 seconds. A separate integration test calls the real session reset service, verifies that it preserves the session and workspace while advancing the lifecycle, then immediately reads Review. The read returns the accepted-base diff without changing the projection. The two diff files pass all 25 tests in 34.39 seconds wall time. The captures below render actual synthetic local diff responses through the maintained browser harness. Matching viewport, theme, layout, and Git contents show two files before the fix and only the authored file afterward. Browser assertions check the requested session, filenames, and patch text. ## Visual evidence []() | Before | After | | --- | --- | | ![Review includes the authored file and an upstream\-only file\.](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e1f2c38d-eebb-40c1-97ee-147ec85ac8c2) | ![Review includes only the authored task file\.](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/511dca01-f28c-4689-b1bc-77b088126fa3) | ### Visual verification - Baseline: 3260d7b41a8c2404b8b3dc800240573dfb1cc7e1 - Exact head: `79697e8233fd92023c8980af2a5d520dcc015c99` - Scenario: Open the persisted Review panel with the real synthetic local diff response, at an equivalent 1180 by 800 light\-theme browser viewport\. - Runtime/build: Backend 79697e8233fd92023c8980af2a5d520dcc015c99; maintained production Control UI harness; assets /assets/index\-CgjwqA4Z\.js - All changes: Before: 2 files, \+2/\-0\. After: 1 file, \+1/\-0\. - Conditions: Equivalent synthetic Git contents, stale default ref, accepted base, viewport, theme, and persisted Review layout\. - Actual local sessions\.diff results rendered by the maintained mocked\-Gateway browser harness\. - Browser assertions cover the session request, filenames, and authored patch text\. - The separate backend regression covers accepted\-base selection, history, commit contents, uncommitted work, and ownership controls\. - Recording omitted: Static backend\-derived Review result; no interaction or transition changed\.
